people.imagined: A brewer, a burn ring round his wrist from a cauldron handle, eager to learn the best brew and testing on servants.
people.subject: The moment: at a great jade-green cauldron he stirs with fierce concentration, then glances up at the viewer with open ambition. Face: most important, a raised pink burn-ring scar all the way round his left wrist, plainly visible below the pushed-back sleeve, and a long iron ladle in his hand. A sharp, ruddy, lean face of thirty-eight, dark eyes, thick brows, a hooked nose, a thin tight smile; the cheeks flushed from heat, sweat shining on his brow. Hair: black, cropped short under a small jade-green hairband. Clothing: three layers of green-grey silk, the collars crossed at the neck with a dark green cord at the waist and a pale green silk inner collar embroidered with silver herb sprigs; a translucent green gauze over-robe, its wide sleeves pushed back above the elbows and scorched at the cuffs; a jade herb pendant hanging from the sash. Hands and objects: the ladle lifts a thread of glowing green liquid from the cauldron. Power: a faint green-orange heat shimmers round the cauldron, a few sparks of wood qi and ember motes rising past his jaw. Background: a vaulted furnace hall of green spirit-fire, rows of cauldrons bubbling in the dark, mist curling to the rafters. Light: emerald glow from the lower left lighting the underside of his chin and brow, leaving the eye sockets dark, with a soft green rim light on the shoulder. He leans forward, weight over the cauldron, shoulders hunched. Expression: an intent, narrowed, hungry concentration, a tight ambitious mouth.

people.imagined: The tally-keeper laughs a round generous laugh she cannot keep down, a tally rod in her hand.
people.subject: The moment: she laughs aloud with her head thrown back, a notched tally rod in one hand, a round generous laugh she cannot keep down. Face: most important, a wide-open laugh, head tipped back, cheeks full, eyes squeezed into crescents. A round, glowing, kind face of about forty, rosy, with soft brows, a short nose, a huge smile and a chin that doubles as she tilts back. Hair: dark brown, in a loose bun held by a pale jade pin. Body: plump and warm, the whole body shaking with the laugh, one hand pressed to her chest. Clothing: flowing green-grey silk in three crossed layers, the pale green silk inner collar loosened at the neck and embroidered with silver wheat-ears and herbs; a dark green cord at the waist, a translucent green gauze over-robe with wide sleeves falling in soft folds over plump forearms, and a small jade herb pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: a tally stick notched with rows of cuts, held up. Power: a faint brown-gold shimmer of earth and wood qi hangs in the air, like grain dust turned to light. Background: a granary hall door standing open on sacks piled high, golden motes drifting in a sunbeam, a cat curled on a sack. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, from the doorway, a soft glow on her cheeks and a gentle rim light on her hair. Expression: generous, honest and delighted, a whole-body laugh that comes before any attempt to stop it.

people.imagined: He walks the array's stones each dawn, his walking stick worn smooth by his grip, calm and faithless in loyalty.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn among standing array stones he leans on a long smooth walking stick and looks calmly at the viewer, loyal in a way he never mentions. Face: most important, a long walking stick of dark wood, polished smooth and pale at the top by a daily grip, held in both hands; at his waist a cord knotted with a count of every stone he has walked. A lean, composed face of thirty-eight, light brown, with calm guarded dark eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose and a closed mouth as if sealing a secret. Hair: black, in a topknot tied with a grey cord worn tight, under a small silver ring. Clothing: layered green-grey silk with crossed collars, the pale green inner collar embroidered with silver mist; a dark green cord and an array-runner's green sash; a translucent green haze-gauze over-robe damp at the hem from dew; a small pouch of chalk and a jade herb pendant at the belt. Power: a faint green haze rises from the stones and wraps his ankles, thin lines of wood qi running between the stones like pale threads. Background: small standing stones in a row in pearly dawn mist, dew on the grass, a faint trodden path between them. Light: pale silver dawn light from the upper left, dew on the stones catching the first glow, a soft rim light along his sleeve. Expression: cautious and calm, a still, closed face that has learned never to be the first to speak.

people.imagined: The investigator in a dry-hem robe, her hair in a knot so neat it looks painted, burning petitions unread.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in a bare hall she regards the viewer coldly, a stack of petitions at her elbow, deciding to burn them unread. Face: most important, a hair knot so perfectly neat and glossy it looks painted on, not a single loose hair. A smooth, pale, impassive face of thirty-eight with cool skin, dark level eyes whose gaze never wavers, two exactly drawn straight brows, a straight nose and a thin firm mouth. Hair: black, in a smooth tight knot with one plain white jade pin. Body: slim and rigid, small hands lying still. Clothing: the Hall of Rules dry undyed robe, rendered as fine pale raw silk, immaculate and without one wrinkle, in three crossed collars edged with a narrow line of silver-grey embroidery of reeds, the narrow sleeves closed at the wrist, a plain flat sash with a dark green cord and a pale jade herb pendant; over it a very faint translucent green-grey gauze. Hands and objects: one hand rests on bundled papers tied with cord. Power: a thin cold grey-green qi lies like frost along the desk edge, no more. Background: a bare hall wall with one empty scroll rod, a pale floor, no ornament. Light: even, cool silver light from the upper left with a thin hard rim light along her cheek, no soft shadow. Expression: just and callous, an unmoved, exact stare that has already decided what to do with the page.

people.imagined: She weeds the osmanthus terraces humming half a tune that never finishes.
people.subject: The moment: weeding among blossoming osmanthus terraces she hums half a tune and looks up smiling, a basket of weeds at her hip. Face: most important, a mouth shaped around a hum, head tilted, a woven basket of weeds at her hip. A warm, plain, rosy face of about fifty, brown skin, kind dark eyes that crinkle, thick brows, a rounded nose, a content smile; cheeks weathered and rosy. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a soft bun with a pale green ribbon and a small silver pin. Body: sturdy, bent a little, one hand at the small of her back. Clothing: graceful green-grey silk in layered crossed collars, a pale green silk inner collar and a dark green cord, wide sleeves tied back with green cord above the elbow, a sheer green gauze outer layer scattered with golden osmanthus petals; hands soil-brown. Hands and objects: a handful of weeds, a small basket. Power: a faint green-gold shimmer drifts up from the soil around her knees, a few glowing motes among the petals. Background: terraces of osmanthus climbing in soft rows, tiny golden flowers, bees, mist among the upper trees. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, dappled through the blossoms with a gentle rim light on her hair, petals glowing as they fall. Expression: a soft, content smile with warm eyes lifted from her work, mid-hum.

people.imagined: He sits beside a spirit tree overnight asking leave to fell it, eyes dropping when an axe is mentioned.
people.subject: The moment: sitting against an old spirit-tree trunk at night, he drops his eyes as someone names the axe, one palm resting on the bark. Face: most important, lowered eyes with long lashes down, and a hand pressed gently flat on the bark as on a sleeper's chest. A gentle, long, pale face of about forty-five, soft dark eyes, thin brows, a long nose, a soft sorrowful mouth, the head bowed a little. Hair: black, in a plain knot held by a slim silver pin. Body: lean and still, knees drawn up. Clothing: flowing green-grey silk with a pale green inner collar and dark green cord, the collars embroidered in silver with tree-rings and mist, a translucent green haze over-robe whose damp hem trails on leaf-mould; a temple-style cord with two tassels at the waist and a jade herb pendant. Hands and objects: one palm on the bark; a small shuttered lantern on a root beside him. Power: a soft green mist rises from the old tree and gathers round his hand, a few pale motes drifting upward, as if the tree answers him. Background: a black forest at night, huge trunks, moonlight silvering a few leaves. Light: soft lantern glow from the lower left leaving half his face in shadow and picking out the wet gleam of his lashes, with a faint moonlit rim on the hair. Expression: sorrowful and gentle, begging leave of a tree.

people.imagined: A boatman's rope scar across both palms, a Cold Ford fighter spitting at the mention of letters.
people.subject: The moment: on a misty river quay he turns his head and spits to the side at the mention of a name, angry and loyal, both palms held open. Face: most important, a thick white rope scar across both palms, both hands held open and showing it. A hard, square, weathered face of thirty-eight, dark, with narrow bloodshot hostile eyes, a vein at the temple, thick brows, a flat nose and a deep scowl, the lip lifted. Hair: black, cropped, bound by a dark blue band. Body: solid, thick-necked, legs wide, chin thrust out, shoulders forward. Clothing: green-grey silk robes cut for a fighter, crossed collars with a pale green inner edge and dark green cord, a translucent green-grey gauze over-robe, short wide sleeves pushed back on thick forearms; a sash of Cold Ford blue embroidered with silver waves, a jade herb pendant, and a cracked dark lacquered bracer on one wrist. Power: a faint blue frost of water qi curls round his fists and the hem, tiny ice motes glittering in the mist. Background: a foggy river quay, a dark boat at the pier, coils of rope, a low grey sky. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the left showing the stubble and the vein in his neck, mist drifting across his boots. Expression: warlike and heavy, a loyal scowl of a boatman who has just heard a name he hates.

people.imagined: She lights the lamp on a Cold Ford boat at dusk with a pleasant blank face that gives nothing away, while she thinks of her monthly letter.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a boat she lights a small paper lantern with a taper and looks up with a pleasantly blank, smooth face, thinking of her monthly letter. Face: most important, a perfectly smooth, blank, pleasant expression, eyes friendly but empty, a lit taper held up beside it, the small flame warm on her cheek. A plain, round, comfortable face of thirty-six, light brown, smooth as a cushion, calm grey-brown eyes, soft level brows, a small nose and a mild small smile. Hair: black, in a neat low bun tied with a blue cord and a silver pin. Body: soft and sturdy. Clothing: graceful green-grey silk, pale green inner collar and dark green cord, a pale blue Cold Ford sash embroidered with silver ripples tied in a plain knot, a translucent green gauze over-robe with sleeves folded back neatly; a tiny silver bell and a jade herb pendant at the belt. Hands and objects: a taper lighting a paper boat lamp. Power: a faint blue water-glow lingers round the lamp, soft motes of light lifting from the flame. Background: a dark river carrying a drifting line of small paper lanterns, a dim far bank, a deep blue sky with the first star. Light: warm taper glow from the lower left against the blue dusk, a soft rim light along the cheek. Expression: peaceable and pleasant, an impenetrable mild smile that gives nothing away.

people.imagined: A pill-ship captain on deck, a bowl of herb broth in one hand and a strip of dried fish in the other, grinning and never saying which he prefers.
people.subject: The moment: at the rail of a pill-ship he raises a bowl of steaming herb broth in one hand and a strip of dried fish in the other, grinning and refusing to say which he prefers. Face: most important, a bowl of dark steaming broth in one hand and a long strip of dried fish in the other, both held up level. A ruddy, laughing, weathered face of thirty-eight, bright blue eyes, thick sun-bleached brows dusted with small salt crystals, a broad red peeling nose, deep laugh-lines and a big grin. Hair: dark brown, salt-stiff, tied with a blue rope cord and a silver ring. Body: stocky and barrel-chested. Clothing: rich green-grey silk robes in layered crossed collars, the pale green inner collar and dark green cord, a blue captain's sash embroidered in silver with waves and stained with fish oil, a translucent green gauze over-robe blowing back from scarred forearms; a brass whistle on a cord and a jade herb pendant at the neck. Power: a faint blue-green water haze curls about the ship's rail, spray motes shining. Background: the ship's rail, coiled ropes and a mast, a pale sea with white-caps and a gull hanging in the wind. Light: bright silver sea-light from the upper left with glittering spray and a bright rim on his shoulder. Expression: gregarious and greedy, a wide laughing look of a captain who wants both and will not choose.

people.imagined: A midwife's daughter on the Green Door Day, sleeves rolled, strong forearms setting a child's bone with a calm word.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a small patient she sets a bone with strong steady hands and murmurs a calm word, sleeves tied high, on the Green Door Day. Face: most important, bare muscular forearms, thick as a smith's, with the sleeves tied high, and steady scrubbed hands on a small arm. A broad, warm, calm face of about forty, brown, with patient dark eyes lined with fatigue, thick soft brows, a broad nose and a gentle mouth. Hair: black, in a low braid wrapped with green cloth and a pale jade pin. Body: broad and sturdy. Clothing: green-grey silk with a pale green inner collar and dark green cord, the collars embroidered in silver with herb leaves, a spotless white silk healer's over-gown, wide gauze sleeves tied above the elbow with green cord, a jade herb pendant and a satchel of splints at her side. Hands and objects: setting a small arm in pale bamboo splints tied with green cord. Power: a soft warm green glow gathers at her fingers and falls over the child's arm, a few motes of wood qi rising like fireflies. Background: a bright healing hall with pallets in rows, bundles of herbs hanging, the green-painted door open to daylight. Light: soft, luminous light from the left, a gentle glow on her face and a warm rim light. Expression: tender, tired and steady, a calm unhurried gentleness in the eyes.

people.imagined: Six years of a leafless life tree; a dried mugwort sprig behind her ear, steady smile through the worry.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a bare sapling she smiles a little tightly, brave about her slow life tree, six years without a leaf. Face: most important, a dried grey-green mugwort sprig tucked behind her right ear, and a leafless small tree beside her. A thin, freckled, earnest face of twenty, fair, dense freckles across the nose, pale lashes, quietly stubborn hazel eyes, thin brows, a small nose and a brave small smile. Hair: light brown, in a plain braid with a pale green ribbon. Body: thin and narrow-shouldered, hands clasped, chin tilted up to seem brave. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple, a soft green-grey robe a little too big, the sleeves cuffed twice, a single crossed collar with a thin line of silver herb embroidery, a plain grey sash tied in a bow, a small gourd at the belt, and a sheer pale gauze scarf. Hands and objects: one hand rests on the sapling's bare twig. Power: none to speak of, only a thin pale green glimmer on the bare twig as if waiting. Background: a misty hillside of young saplings tied with coloured cords, one among them bare. Light: pale silver dawn light and drifting mist falling on her freckled face, a faint rim glow on her braid. Expression: a small steady smile worn tightly over worried eyes, brave and hopeful.

people.imagined: A carter's son carrying soil in the evening for a friend's plot, red soil dried on his shins.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a heavy basket of earth in the evening for a friend's plot, he pauses and wipes his brow. Face: most important, dried red soil caked on both shins and the hem of his robe, and a basket of dark earth on his back. A broad, open, sunburnt face of nineteen, brown skin, steady dark eyes, thick brows, a blunt nose, a friendly mouth, a smear of red earth on his jaw. Hair: black, short, tied with a plain grey band. Body: big and strong, leaning slightly forward under the weight, thumbs hooked in the straps. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful green-grey silk, crossed collars with a thin silver-embroidered edge, a grey sash gone dusty, wide sleeves rolled and tied back, the hem stiff with red clay. Hands and objects: a strap of the basket, a spade stuck in the earth behind him. Power: a faint brown earth haze glimmers about his boots, a few amber motes rising from the soil. Background: a hillside plot being dug in the last light, a rosy twilight sky, mist beginning in the valley. Light: low warm golden-rose evening light from the left lighting the red clay to a rust glow, a soft rim light on his shoulder, a long shadow across the plot. Expression: a tired, gentle face with a damp brow and a mild, faithful smile.

people.imagined: Dark rings under his eyes from watering his silent tree three times a day, envious and tired.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a watering can before dawn, he looks at the viewer with exhausted, envious eyes. Face: most important, very dark rings under both eyes, deep and plain, and a wooden watering can in his hand. A thin, pale, tired face of twenty-three, dark restless eyes, thin brows, a sharp nose, a tight mouth; the eyes sunken and red-rimmed, lips dry, a day's stubble on his chin. Hair: black, untidy, escaping a plain cord. Body: thin and stooped, shoulders high, knuckles whitening on the handle. Clothing: a simple outer-disciple silk of green-grey with a single crossed collar and thin silver-embroidered border, damp at the hem, a grey sash crooked at the waist, the wide sleeves wet to the elbow. Hands and objects: both hands clutching the can's handle like a lifeline, drops falling from the spout onto his sandals. Power: only a pale green glimmer clinging to the water. Background: the first grey light on rows of tagged saplings, mist coiling in the hollows, a single bird. Light: cold grey-blue pre-dawn spirit-light from the left, showing every shadow of his sleepless face, with a thin cool rim light along the jaw. Expression: a tight, anxious mouth and restless, sunken eyes, determined but envious of every tree that has already leafed, the face of a man who has not slept.

people.imagined: The younger sister oils the halls and keeps retying her oil-stained apron strings, bet she'll reach the First Leaf first.
people.subject: The moment: retying the strings of her apron behind her back, she twists at the waist and looks over her shoulder with a competitive grin; she has bet she will reach the First Leaf first. Face: most important, oil-darkened silk ties of a sash knotted in a quick bow at her waist, shiny and stained amber. A round, bright, freckled face of twenty-one, brown, round amber-smudged cheeks, sparkling dark eyes, thick brows lifted in challenge, a snub nose and a cheeky grin. Hair: black, in two high buns with green ribbons, a wisp stuck to her cheek. Body: small and quick, one shoulder dropped and chin over it. Clothing: an outer disciple's graceful green-grey silk, a single crossed collar with silver herb embroidery, wide sleeves tied up with cords, a grey silk sash darkened amber by oil, a pale gauze over-layer with a small rag tucked in the belt. Hands and objects: both hands behind her tying the sash. Power: a faint pale green tint gathers on the oiled ties. Background: a lacquered hall pillar shining amber with fresh oil, a pot and brush on the floor, a warm hall filled with glowing lanterns. Light: warm amber lantern-light from the left bouncing off the oiled wood, lending her skin a glow, a soft rim light on the hair. Expression: ambitious and cheeky, a quick competitive grin thrown over the shoulder.

people.imagined: A warden's niece with her uncle's long jaw, asking bright questions about furnaces.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in with an eager question, her hand raised, asking bright questions about furnaces. Face: most important, a long angular jaw, her uncle the warden's, strong and prominent in a young face. A long, lively, fair face of twenty-four with a flush on the cheeks, keen alert green-brown eyes, arched brows, a straight nose and an eager open mouth. Hair: chestnut, in a high braid with a carved wooden pin. Body: tall and slim, chin tilted up, one foot half a step forward. Clothing: graceful green-grey silk with crossed collars, pale green inner collar and dark green cord, the cuff flashing a lining of pine-green, wide sleeves, one smudged with charcoal; a small notebook of folded paper hanging from the sash with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: her free hand lifted, fingertips together, as if weighing the answer. Power: a faint green-gold tint glimmers at her fingers, a few motes of wood qi. Background: the furnace hall door glowing green behind her, the shadows of cauldrons looming, warm air shimmering. Light: emerald glow from the lower left tinting one side of her face and caught in her bright eyes, a soft rim light on the braid. Expression: curious, trusting, the open hungry look of a girl who expects every question to have a good answer.

people.imagined: A cousin from the poria village, dimples she is annoyed at, reminding her rival she joined first.
people.subject: The moment: arms folded, she smirks with a toss of the head, dimples showing and annoyed by them, reminding her rival that she joined first. Face: most important, deep dimples in both cheeks, clearly marked even as she tries to frown. A round, rosy, bright face of seventeen, brown, sparkling mock-fierce dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose and a smirk. Hair: black, in two braids tied with green ribbons that glow in the morning light, a tiny silver bell on one. Body: small and brisk, weight on one hip, chin lifted, a foot tapping. Clothing: an outer disciple's crisp graceful green-grey silk, a single crossed collar with silver herb embroidery, wide sleeves rolled up for a quarrel, a grey sash in a neat bow, a sheer pale gauze scarf. Hands and objects: arms crossed, fingers drumming on the sleeve. Power: a faint pale green sparkle in the ribbons. Background: a pale stone courtyard with a small fountain among mist, a few students looking on. Light: bright pearly morning light from the left, deepening the shadows in her dimples, a rim glow on her braids. Expression: smug and stubborn, cheerful, the satisfied challenging look of a girl who has been first all her life.

people.imagined: A stonecutter's sister sent north, walking with a stiff, unbowed back among the terrace stones; she has not accepted this life.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight among stacked terrace stones, chin high, refusing to bend; a stonecutter's sister sent north who has not accepted this life. Face: most important, a strikingly rigid upright spine and carriage, chin up, shoulders back, the whole small frame drawn to its full height. A proud, square, tanned face of seventeen with a set square jaw, dark defiant eyes under thick straight brows, a short nose and a tight mouth. Hair: black, in a tight single braid with a plain grey cord. Body: sturdy, heels together, fists clenched at her sides. Clothing: an outer disciple's neat, slightly stiff green-grey silk with a single crossed collar and thin silver embroidery, a grey sash tied tight, cuffs dusty with stone, a sheer gauze scarf held straight. Hands and objects: one hand resting on a stone, the other fist tight. Power: a faint brown earth glimmer and a few amber motes at her boots. Background: stacked terrace stones in neat piles, a half-built wall, a pale sky with drifting mist. Light: bright cool spirit-light from the left flattening her proud face into clean planes, a thin rim light, the shadow of the stones across her boots. Expression: proud and resentful, holding herself together by standing straight.

people.imagined: A raftsman who has fallen in the river more than any disciple, fresh bruise on the cheek, dripping and laughing.
people.subject: The moment: dripping wet, hauling himself out of a river onto a log with a rueful laugh, having fallen in more than any disciple. Face: most important, a fresh dark purple-yellow bruise on his cheekbone and wet hair plastered to his brow. A boyish, cheerful, battered face of twenty-five, brown, bright dark eyes shut in laughter, thick brows, a crooked nose and a wide laugh. Hair: black, soaked and plastered. Body: lean and strong, sprawled half across the log, one knee up, shoulders heaving. Clothing: wet green-grey silk clinging to him, crossed collars with silver wave embroidery, a dripping blue river sash, a clinging translucent gauze sleeve pushed up over a long scrape down one forearm, a pale green inner collar and cord; a jade herb pendant swinging. Hands and objects: both hands gripping a wet black log. Power: a faint blue water mist and spray motes rise around him, tiny glittering droplets. Background: a brown river running fast with floating logs, a muddy bank, spray catching light in small rainbows. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the left blazing off the wet skin, the river throwing light up under his chin. Expression: cheerful and rueful, a laugh with the eyes shut and no embarrassment in it.

people.imagined: The only disciple the spirit bees have never stung, bees circling her hair, sweet scent.
people.subject: The moment: standing calm while several golden bees circle her head and rest in her hair. Face: most important, golden bees crawling in her hair and on her shoulders, undisturbed, and a serene smile. A soft, round, sweet face of twenty, golden-brown skin, warm amber eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a gentle smile; a bee rests on her eyebrow. Hair: honey-brown, in a loose braid with bees. Body: slim and relaxed, arms slightly out from her sides, palms up. Clothing: an outer disciple's flowing green-grey silk with a pale yellow cord, a single crossed collar embroidered in silver with honeycomb and clover, loose sleeves falling in soft folds, a sheer gauze veil at the shoulders, a few bees on her collar. Hands and objects: open palms with a bee on one. Power: a faint golden shimmer of wood qi hangs round her, the bees leaving slow golden threads of light. Background: white hives in a meadow of clover, a haze of bees, a warm blue sky softened with mist. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the left turning her hair to honey and making her eyes glow amber, a soft rim light. Expression: serene, half-lidded eyes and a soft quiet smile as the bees settle.

people.imagined: A letter-runner who glances over his shoulder so the Cold Ford watch does not see him come.
people.subject: The moment: on a misty pine path he glances nervously over his shoulder, a letter satchel clutched to his chest, so the Cold Ford watch will not see him come. Face: most important, a quick nervous glance over the shoulder, head half turned, eyes wide, the satchel held tight. A narrow, pale, anxious face of twenty-six, wide brown eyes, thin brows, a long nose, a tight worried mouth, sweat at the hairline. Hair: black, short, bound with a narrow green band. Body: thin and tense, one shoulder high. Clothing: graceful green-grey silk with a pale green inner collar and dark green cord, the collars lined in silver mist embroidery, narrow sleeves tied at the wrist, a translucent green haze over-robe whose hem is muddy, a messenger's cord belt with a small jade pendant; a lacquered letter-tube strapped to his back. Hands and objects: a worn leather satchel gripped under his arm, the other hand on his sleeve. Power: a faint green haze clings to him, the satchel leaking a thin silver thread of light. Background: a misty path winding between dark pines, a leaning signpost. Light: cool silver-grey moonlit mist from the left, leaving his face grey and his wide eyes shining, a faint rim light. Expression: nervous, evasive and alert.

people.imagined: Dozing beside a spirit tree at night, head nodding at the quietest moments.
people.subject: The moment: dozing beside a spirit tree at night, head nodding down toward his chest at the quietest moment. Face: most important, a head drooping forward with closed eyes, mid-nod, mouth a little open. A round, soft, boyish face of twenty-four, fair, closed eyes with dark lashes, thick brows, a snub nose, a slack mouth, soft flushed cheeks. Hair: brown, tousled, a silver hairpin sliding loose. Body: slouched and heavy, arms loose. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful green-grey silk, a single crossed collar with thin silver embroidery of leaves, a grey sash loosened, a damp translucent gauze hem trailing on moss, a temple-style cord, a soft blanket sliding off one knee. Hands and objects: a cloth blanket in his lap. Power: a faint pale green mist drifts from the old tree, a few fireflies and motes hovering over his head. Background: a black forest around a huge spirit tree, a single low lantern, fireflies. Light: soft lantern light from the lower left making a small warm island on his cheek and the roots, moonlight silvering the leaves above. Expression: sleepy and peaceful, the mouth soft, a little guilty even in his dream, as if he knows he was meant to keep watch through the quietest hour of the night.

people.imagined: The fire-tender whose nose twitches at every smell, sniffing a log to tell spirit wood from dead.
people.subject: The moment: sniffing a freshly split log with a twitching nose, eyes closed, sure of himself, telling spirit wood from dead. Face: most important, a long nose twitching and wrinkled mid-sniff, held close to a split log. A thin, eager, soot-smudged face of twenty-two, dark-skinned, closed creased eyes, thick brows, a pleased mouth, sweat above his lip. Hair: black and short, bound in a plain green cloth. Body: lean and wiry, shoulders raised, bending forward. Clothing: a junior inner disciple's graceful green-grey silk with a pale green inner collar embroidered with silver flame leaves, wide sleeves tied back with cord, a soot-grey sash greasy from work, a sheer green gauze scorched at the hem. Hands and objects: a split log held in both hands to his nose, hands streaked with ash, the cut face pale and rich with rings and resin. Power: a faint green flicker of wood-fire qi lifts from the cut face, a few ember motes. Background: a furnace of green flames, a stack of logs, a green-orange glow on the brick. Light: emerald glow from the lower left washing his sooty cheeks and highlighting sweat on his forehead, a faint rim light. Expression: diligent and pleased, a rapt eyes-shut concentration like a man tasting wine.

people.imagined: A coil of measuring cord always on her wrist, a junior mapping where the stones would be.
people.subject: The moment: measuring between two array stones with a cord stretched taut in both hands, her head turned to sight along it. Face: most important, a neat coil of measuring cord worn round her wrist like a bracelet, and another cord pulled tight in both hands. A sharp, neat, serious face of twenty-one, pale, bright quick dark eyes, straight brows, a small nose, a tight focused mouth. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a silver pin. Body: slim and upright, feet apart, arms outstretched. Clothing: a junior inner disciple's graceful green-grey silk, a pale green inner collar and dark green cord, chalk-white cuffs embroidered with silver circles and lines, a sheer green gauze over-robe tidily belted, a small plumb bob like a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: stretching a red waxed cord knotted at hand intervals, the coil on her wrist. Power: a faint green line of light follows the cord between the stones, motes of wood qi along it. Background: array stones standing in a precise line in dawn mist, dew on the grass. Light: pale silver dawn light from the left giving her face a clear precise outline, dew shining silver, a thin rim glow. Expression: focused and ambitious, the narrowed exact attention of a junior mapping where the stones will be.

people.imagined: A junior clerk with spotless hem edges even on the slope, quietly correcting a verdict he dislikes.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk he corrects a page with one small neat stroke and glances up, unrepentant. Face: most important, a pure dry spotless hem edge of his robe visible at the lower frame, immaculately clean, and a calm self-righteous face. A neat, narrow, pale face of twenty-seven, cold dark eyes, thin brows, a sharp nose, a prim mouth, smooth skin. Hair: black, tightly tied under a small white jade crown. Body: slim, spine perfectly straight, elbow squared. Clothing: the Hall of Rules dry undyed robe as fine pale raw silk, immaculate, in crossed collars edged with narrow silver-grey reed embroidery, sleeves closed at the wrist, a dark flat sash with a green cord and jade herb pendant, a faint translucent grey-green gauze over it. Hands and objects: a brush held like a scalpel over a white page, a neat brush holder. Power: a thin cold grey-green shimmer along the brush, nothing more. Background: a bare hall wall, a clean desk with one closed book, cool white spirit-light. Light: flat cool silver light from the left leaving no shadow on his smooth face and making the page glow, a hard thin rim light on the jaw. Expression: just, self-righteous and cold.

people.imagined: Watering a friend's unsown plot when nobody is looking, a wheat-gold plait to her waist.
people.subject: The moment: tiptoeing with a watering gourd cradled to her chest, glancing round, about to water a friend's bare plot when nobody is looking. Face: most important, a thick wheat-gold plait to her waist, shining pale yellow over her shoulder. A warm, round, open face of twenty-four, fair, soft light brown eyes, soft brows, a short nose, a few freckles, a shy smile. Hair: wheat-gold, in a long braid that swings as she moves, a pale green ribbon at the end. Body: tall and soft, shoulders hunched. Clothing: a junior inner disciple's flowing green-grey silk, the pale green inner collar loosened and embroidered with silver wheat-ears, sleeves rolled, a translucent gauze over-robe with a few strands of straw at the hem, a jade herb pendant. Hands and objects: a small brown calabash wrapped in a cord net, dripping on her toes. Power: a faint brown-gold glow gathers around the gourd, motes of earth and wood qi falling with the drops. Background: an unsown plot of bare earth, a low fence, a golden evening sky softened with haze. Light: golden evening spirit-light from the left lighting the wheat-gold hair and turning the bare earth rosy, long gold shadows behind her. Expression: kind and furtive, the guilty tender look of someone doing a good deed in secret and fearful of thanks.

people.imagined: Pale as a cold jar, born at the new seat, wondering why anyone would go back up the mountain.
people.subject: The moment: in the seed vault she holds a cold frosted clay jar and looks puzzled, wondering why anyone would go back up the mountain. Face: most important, extremely pale skin, bluish-white like a cold jar, and a frosty clay seed jar held to her chest. A thin, delicate face of twenty, milk-pale, light grey eyes, pale brows, a small nose, a closed small mouth, lips pale as a petal. Hair: pale brown, in a low knot with a white jade pin. Body: slim, still, shoulders narrow, a slight lean back. Clothing: a junior inner disciple's silk in pale grey-green, a pale green inner collar embroidered with silver frost-ferns, a cool-grey gauze shawl pinned at the throat with a small jade pin, a clean sash and dark green cord. Hands and objects: both hands holding the jar against her breastbone. Power: a faint frost-green mist rises from the jar and her hands, glittering ice motes. Background: shelves of frosted jars in rows, thin mist from a cold vent. Light: cool blue spirit-light from the vent at the left leaving her skin ghostly and frosting the glaze with highlights, a pale rim light. Expression: puzzled, cool and very young, a faint crease between the pale brows, the face of a girl born far from the old mountain who cannot see why anyone would climb back to it.

people.imagined: A climber's bow-legged stance on the cliff path, deciding sparring bouts by mood.
people.subject: The moment: on a cliff path he stands in a wide bow-legged stance with arms folded, judging, deciding a sparring bout by mood. Face: most important, a deliberate bowed-leg wide stance, knees out, and arms crossed. A hard, tanned, squared face of twenty-six, sharp narrow dark eyes sliding sideways, thick brows, a flat nose, a mocking mouth, a line of sweat down the jaw, stubble. Hair: black, cropped, a dark band at the brow. Body: stocky, short and strong, thick arms folded, one shoulder dropped in contempt. Clothing: the Cliff Hall dry undyed robe as fine raw silk, clean, with short wide sleeves and crossed collars edged with silver cliff-and-pine embroidery, a heavy dark sash with a jade herb pendant, silver-studded dark bracers, a translucent grey-green over-gauze stirring in the wind. Hands and objects: knuckles scarred, thumbs showing under folded arms. Power: a faint grey-green sheen of qi on the bracers, a few pale motes. Background: a cliff path winding into mist, a few pines clinging to the edge, a pale sky. Light: cold grey-silver light from the left leaving one side of the face in shadow, picking out the sweat and the stubble, a bright rim light. Expression: tough and proud, the heavy-lidded sideways glance of a man who has already made up his mind.

people.imagined: A big gap-toothed grin on a plain round face, making the Cliff Hall laugh.
people.subject: The moment: laughing with a huge grin, she makes a joke in a grim place, making the Cliff Hall laugh. Face: most important, a big wide grin showing a gap between her front teeth. A plain, round, jolly face of twenty-three, brown, shiny round cheeks, small bright eyes, thick brows, a flat nose. Hair: brown, in a thick short plait with a silver clasp. Body: round and sturdy, rocking back with the laugh, arms flung wide, the sleeves swinging. Clothing: the Cliff Hall dry undyed robe as pale raw silk, clean, crossed collars with silver cliff embroidery, wide sleeves rolled, a white wax-silk sash tied in a bow with a smudge of wax on one cuff, a sheer grey-green gauze over-robe and a jade herb pendant. Hands and objects: arms spread wide in the telling, broad pink palms. Power: a faint pale green tint at her fingers, a few motes. Background: a stone hall with a long table, a few other disciples laughing, a warm lamp, their shadows jiggling on the wall. Light: soft grey-silver light from the left with warm lamplight warming her round cheeks, a glow on her forehead and a rim light. Expression: jolly and warm, a huge easy gap-toothed laugh that lifts the room.

people.imagined: The cook's grandson peeling roots, knife scars up his left forearm, taking his grandfather's side on salt.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy kitchen he peels a root with a short knife and looks up defiantly, taking his grandfather's side on salt. Face: most important, a ladder of thin white knife scars up his left forearm, shown with the sleeve rolled, and a root and knife in his hands. A round, flushed, cheeky face of nineteen, brown skin, bright eyes, thick brows, a blunt nose, a stubborn crooked half-grin, a smear of flour on his forehead. Hair: black, cropped, a cloth band round his brow. Body: stocky, hunched over the root with elbows out. Clothing: a servant's plain but clean tunic of soft brown silk-cotton with a crossed collar, a clean white apron stained from work, the left sleeve rolled, hands red from cold water; no sect finery and no jewels. Hands and objects: peeling a pale root with the knife. Power: none. Background: a steamy kitchen with a big iron pot, hanging ladles, a basket of unpeeled roots, mist-soft steam. Light: warm firelight from the lower left glinting on the scarred forearm, a faint rim light through the steam. Expression: cheeky and defiant, chin raised, bright stubborn eyes and a crooked half-grin, ready to argue his grandfather's case against anyone who calls the soup too salty.

people.imagined: The gatekeeper's daughter sweeping the founder's grave at dawn, pine needles pressed into her braid.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she sweeps needles off the founder's grave and looks up gently; she is the gatekeeper's daughter. Face: most important, dry pine needles pressed into her braid like pins, and a soft pine-twig broom held upright in her hand. A thin, quiet, pale face of twenty-four, gentle grey eyes under long lashes, thin brows, a small nose, a gentle mouth. Hair: black, in a long braid stuck with pine needles. Body: slender, standing with the broom held like a staff, her weight on one foot, head slightly bowed. Clothing: a plain, clean robe of undyed pale silk-cotton with a single crossed collar, sleeves rolled, a soft grey-green gauze shawl and a simple sash; a servant's dress, graceful but unadorned, with a faint smudge of pine resin. Hands and objects: both hands on a broom of twigs bound with fresh bark. Power: a faint green mist rises from the grave and a few pale gold motes drift with the needles. Background: an old stone grave under a spreading pine, needles in drifts, a pale dawn sky and thin mist. Light: pale silver dawn light from the left, soft on her face, single needles gold at the tips drifting down through it. Expression: gentle and quiet, the calm lowered look of a girl who has swept this grave every morning for as long as she can remember.
